question.zh: 卷积神经网络是怎样从笔画像认出数字的？
question.en: How does a convolutional network turn pen strokes into a digit?

hook.zh: 画一个数字，或点示例。输入层亮起像素，卷积摸边缘，池化压缩，最后 Softmax 给 0–9 投票。
hook.en: Draw a digit or tap a sample. The input lights pixels, conv finds edges, pooling compresses, Softmax votes 0–9.

payoff.zh: 这是教育用的 LeNet 风格 MNIST 网络（约六千参数）：卷积提取局部特征，池化缩小图，全连接层做分类——现代视觉模型更深，但流水线思想一脉相承。
payoff.en: An educational LeNet-style MNIST net (~6k params): convolution extracts local features, pooling shrinks maps, a dense layer classifies—modern vision models go deeper, but share this pipeline idea.

question.zh: 神经网络是怎样从数据中学会分类的？
question.en: How do neural networks learn to classify from data?

hook.zh: 选择一组数据，开始训练，看网络如何调整分类边界。再改变网络结构和学习率，比较错误的变化。
hook.en: Choose a dataset and start training to watch the classification boundary change. Then adjust the network and learning rate to compare the errors.

payoff.zh: 反向传播计算每个权重对误差的影响，再按学习率调整权重。更复杂的网络能表达更复杂的边界，但不保证学得更好；还要留意过拟合和未见过的数据。
payoff.en: Backpropagation computes how each weight affects the error, and the learning rate sets the size of an update. A more complex network can represent more complex boundaries, but it does not guarantee better learning. Watch for overfitting and performance on unseen data.

question.zh: 为什么最亮的内焰未必最热，暗暗的焰心里又有什么？
question.en: Why is the brightest region not necessarily the hottest, and what is inside the dark core?

hook.zh: 从蜡池沿烛芯进入火焰，逐层观察焰心、内焰和外焰。打开半剖面，追踪燃料与空气，再探索原子守恒、缺氧产物、放热和自由基链反应。
hook.en: Travel from the wax pool through the wick into the flame. Explore its dark core, luminous zone and outer reaction region, trace fuel and air, then explore conserved atoms, incomplete combustion, heat feedback and radical chain reactions.

payoff.zh: 液蜡沿烛芯上升并汽化；焰心富燃料而少氧，内焰的烟炱受热发亮，外焰获得更多氧气并发生更充分的氧化。最亮处未必最热。地球上，受热气体密度降低，浮力使它上升，周围空气补入，火焰因此向上延伸。在空气近乎静止的微重力环境，浮力对流减弱，扩散变得重要，蜡烛火焰可呈蓝色圆顶。金黄色主要来自炽热烟炱，蓝色包含化学发光；颜色不能单独当作温度计。
payoff.en: Liquid wax rises through the wick and vaporizes. The dark core is fuel-rich and oxygen-poor; hot soot lights the luminous zone, while more oxygen supports oxidation near the outside. Brightest need not mean hottest. On Earth, heated gas becomes less dense and buoyancy carries it upward, drawing surrounding air in and elongating the flame. In quiet microgravity, buoyant convection weakens and diffusion becomes important; a candle flame can form a blue dome. Yellow light largely comes from incandescent soot, while blue includes chemiluminescence. Color alone is not a thermometer.

topicLabel.zh: 烛火分区 · 燃料、氧气与发光
topicLabel.en: Candle anatomy · Fuel, oxygen and light

label.zh: 未完全燃烧的产物，还会继续反应
label.en: Incomplete products can react further

body.zh: 来到更富氧、足够热的区域，一氧化碳可进一步氧化：2 CO + O₂ → 2 CO₂。烟炱中的碳也可氧化为二氧化碳：C + O₂ → CO₂。这把黄色内焰与外侧反应区连接起来；总式依然省略表面反应和中间步骤。
body.en: In a sufficiently hot, more oxygen-rich region, carbon monoxide can oxidize further: 2 CO + O₂ → 2 CO₂. Carbon in soot can also oxidize: C + O₂ → CO₂. This connects the yellow luminous region with outer oxidation. These overall equations omit surface chemistry and intermediate steps.

label.zh: 方程式是原子账本
label.en: Equations account for atoms

body.zh: 动画用甲烷举例，CH₄ + 2 O₂ → CO₂ + 2 H₂O；烛蜡本身不是甲烷。不完全燃烧的两条总式表示可能的产物，不表示反应一步完成或产物比例。真实火焰可以同时产生CO₂、CO和烟炱。
body.en: The animation uses methane: CH₄ + 2 O₂ → CO₂ + 2 H₂O. Candle wax is not methane. The two incomplete-combustion equations indicate possible products, not single elementary steps or product ratios. Real flames may produce CO₂, CO and soot together.

label.zh: 热与链反应
label.en: Heat and chain reactions

body.zh: 断键吸能，成键放能；净能量差决定整体是否放热。H + O₂ → O + OH只是高温链分支的一步，不是完整燃烧机制。燃烧维持还需要燃料、氧化剂、足够的热与持续的链反应。供氧恢复不会自动重新点燃已经熄灭的场景。
body.en: Breaking bonds takes energy; forming bonds releases it. The net difference determines whether the reaction is exothermic. H + O₂ → O + OH is one high-temperature branching step, not the whole mechanism. Sustained combustion needs fuel, oxidizer, sufficient heat and continuing chain reactions. Restoring air does not automatically relight an extinguished scene.

label.zh: 不是所有火都生成二氧化碳
label.en: Not every fire produces carbon dioxide

body.zh: 这里聚焦烃类燃料。氢气燃烧生成水：2 H₂ + O₂ → 2 H₂O。镁在氧气中生成氧化镁：2 Mg + O₂ → 2 MgO。燃烧产物取决于燃料与氧化剂；烛火不能代表所有燃烧。
body.en: This world focuses on hydrocarbon fuels. Hydrogen combustion produces water: 2 H₂ + O₂ → 2 H₂O. Magnesium reacts with oxygen to form magnesium oxide: 2 Mg + O₂ → 2 MgO. Products depend on fuel and oxidizer; a candle does not represent every kind of combustion.

label.zh: 三层分区是观察方法
label.en: Three zones are an observational convention

body.zh: 这里用焰心、内焰、外焰对应富燃料暗区、黄色烟炱亮区、外侧氧化反应区。蓝色根部也属于重要的局部特征；实际区域相互过渡，不是三层实体壳。剖面和外缘颜色经过增强，不表示肉眼能直接看见这些清楚边界。
body.en: The three labels refer to a fuel-rich dark core, yellow luminous soot region and outer oxidation region. The blue foot is another important feature. These regions merge gradually rather than forming solid shells. The section and outer-edge colors are enhanced; the sharp teaching boundaries are not directly visible in an ordinary flame.

label.zh: 燃烧的物质与能量
label.en: Matter and energy in combustion

body.zh: 石蜡是多种烃的混合物。总体完全燃烧可概括为烃与氧气反应生成二氧化碳和水，同时释放能量；真实火焰经历许多中间反应，也可能留下未完全氧化的产物。热反馈维持液蜡供给与汽化。示踪只表达输运关系，不是分子轨迹或反应速率预测。
body.en: Paraffin is a mixture of hydrocarbons. Its overall complete combustion produces carbon dioxide and water and releases energy. Real flames pass through many intermediate reactions and may leave incompletely oxidized products. Heat feedback maintains wax supply and vaporization. Tracers show transport relationships, not molecular trajectories or predicted reaction rates.

label.zh: 模型边界
label.en: Model boundaries

body.zh: 这是近景放大的定性可视化，不求解燃烧化学或流体方程。中间重力的轮廓、亮度和过渡时间是艺术化插值，不是实验预测。示踪点表示空气输运方向，不代表单个分子运动。相对供氧、烟羽与熄灭只作定性演示，不表示氧浓度、产物比例或真实熄灭阈值；省略燃料消耗；静止微重力端点不代表所有太空火焰。
body.en: This magnified qualitative visualization does not solve reacting-flow equations. Intermediate silhouettes, brightness and transition times are artistic interpolation, not experimental predictions. Tracers illustrate transport directions rather than molecular trajectories. Air supply, soot and extinction are qualitative illustrations, not oxygen concentrations, product ratios or predicted extinction thresholds. Fuel consumption is omitted; the quiet-microgravity endpoint does not describe every space flame.

label.zh: 微重力仍然需要空气
label.en: Microgravity still needs air

body.zh: 这里表示有空气的自由落体实验环境。微重力不等于真空，也不表示轨道上没有引力。
body.en: The scene represents freefall in an air-filled experiment. Microgravity is neither a vacuum nor the absence of gravity in orbit.

question.zh: 你手里这块玻璃，是从多少个国家挖出来的？
question.en: How many countries were mined to make the glass in your hand?

hook.zh: 点开手机的任意一层，看它用到的元素在周期表上依次点亮；再点一个元素，看它从世界哪些角落被挖出来，划着弧线汇回你手上。
hook.en: Open any layer of the phone and watch its elements light up across the periodic table; pick an element and watch it rise from the corners of the world and arc back into your hand.

payoff.zh: 一部手机被逐层拆开、溶解、送进质谱仪后，能数出 53 种金属：铁最多，有 16 克；金只有 16.8 毫克，却占了整机金属价值的七成。真正让人愣住的不是种类，而是产地——钴的 76% 来自刚果（金），镓的 98% 来自中国，钽的六成出自刚果（金）与卢旺达。「供应链风险」这个抽象词，说的就是地图上那几个刺眼的光点。反过来看，它也是一座城市矿山：整机里的金比富金矿石还要浓 34 倍，只算主板则是 234 倍。
payoff.en: Peel a smartphone apart layer by layer, dissolve each one and run it through a mass spectrometer, and 53 metals come out. Iron leads with 16 grams; gold amounts to just 16.8 milligrams yet carries about seventy percent of the metal value. What stops you is not the variety but the geography—76% of cobalt comes from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 98% of gallium from China, and about sixty percent of tantalum from the DRC and Rwanda. “Supply-chain risk” is simply the name for those few glaring dots on the map. Read it the other way and the phone is an urban mine: gold in a whole handset is 34 times more concentrated than in rich primary ore, and 234 times on the circuit board alone.

question.zh: 没有领袖，鸟群如何飞出统一的形状？
question.en: Without a leader, how does a flock fly in unified shapes?

hook.zh: 每只鸟只看附近同伴：太近就让开，方向不一样就跟一点，离队太远就往回靠。没有谁需要看见整个鸟群。
hook.en: Each bird sees only nearby neighbors: move apart when too close, turn a little toward their heading, and move back when drifting away. No bird needs to see the whole flock.

payoff.zh: Craig Reynolds 在 1987 年用这三条局部规则做出了 Boids。鸟群的统一形状不是领队发出的命令，而是许多次很小的避让、转向和靠近叠在一起。
payoff.en: Craig Reynolds built Boids from these three local rules in 1987. A flock’s unified shape is not an order from a leader; it is the sum of many tiny acts of avoiding, turning, and regrouping.

question.zh: 太阳喷出的粒子，为什么在两极变成光帘？
question.en: Why do particles from the Sun turn into curtains of light at the poles?

hook.zh: 从行星际空间看地球：太阳风撞上磁层，磁场把带电粒子导进南北极的光环。拨大太阳风强度，极光椭圆会扩大、变亮，一路压向低纬度。
hook.en: See Earth from interplanetary space: the solar wind strikes the magnetosphere and the field funnels charged particles into two glowing ovals. Crank up the wind and the auroral oval expands toward the equator.

payoff.zh: 极光不是「大气在发光」，是被磁层引导的太阳风粒子撞进高层大气的辉光：绿色来自 100 km 高的氧原子，红色来自更高的氧，紫色来自氮。Kp 指数每涨一级，光环就向赤道推进几度。
payoff.en: Aurora is not “the air glowing” — it is solar-wind particles guided by the magnetosphere into the upper atmosphere: green from oxygen at 100 km, red from higher oxygen, purple from nitrogen. Every Kp level pushes the oval a few degrees equatorward.

hook.zh: 从深空启程，亲手推进一次靠近、近掠与远离。你可以藏起飞行器，只留下被黑洞弯曲成光环的星海。
hook.en: Set out from deep space and guide a complete approach, close pass, and departure. Hide the spacecraft to leave only a sea of stars bent into rings by the black hole.

payoff.zh: 停在黑洞旁并不等于失重，飞船必须持续加速；熄火后才进入自由落体。速度足够时，轨迹会在最近点转弯并重新逃向深空。
payoff.en: Hovering near a black hole is not weightlessness: the ship must keep accelerating. In fast enough free fall, the geodesic bends around closest approach and escapes back into deep space.

question.zh: 同一个瞬间，地球上的不同地方正在经历什么？
question.en: What is happening in different places on Earth at the same instant?

hook.zh: 在同一颗三维地球上定位经纬度、追踪晨昏线、比较四季昼长、观察五带和太阳影子。课堂预设、两地比较与场景链接让每个问题都能亲手验证。
hook.en: Locate coordinates, follow dawn, compare seasonal daylight, and explore latitude zones and shadows on one 3D Earth. Classroom examples, two-place comparisons and shareable scenes turn questions into experiments.

payoff.zh: 经纬度用角度描述位置，自转使地点穿过晨昏线，地轴倾斜和公转改变不同纬度的日照。五带描述太阳照射条件；太阳高度决定水平地面上竖杆的影长。地方太阳时随经度变化，钟表时间还受法定时区影响。
payoff.en: Coordinates locate places with angles. Rotation carries them across dawn and dusk; axial tilt and orbit change daylight across latitudes. hook.zh: 在三维空间中追踪太阳、地球、月球的相对位置，看本影和半影如何扫过地球或月球表面。
hook.en: Track the relative positions of the Sun, Earth, and Moon in three-dimensional space and see how the umbra and penumbra sweep across the Earth or Moon's surface.

payoff.zh: 日食发生在新月且月球靠近轨道交点时；月食发生在满月且月球进入地球阴影时。月球轨道倾角约 5°，大约是日月视直径的十倍，所以一年里只有两段食季才会形成食。
payoff.en: A solar eclipse occurs at new moon near a node; a lunar eclipse occurs when a full moon enters Earth's shadow. The Moon's orbit is tilted by about 5°—roughly ten times the apparent size of the Sun or Moon—so eclipses only happen during two eclipse seasons each year.

payoff.en: True scale uses one linear scale for the Sun, planets, moons and distances; the illustrated view preserves Sun, planet and moon diameter ratios while compressing orbit distances. Markers are not body sizes; close-ups use separate zoom levels. Planets use fixed J2000 elements and Keplerian orbits, with the Earth–Moon barycentre approximating Earth. Twenty selected moons use mean sizes, approximate ellipses and orbital periods; initial phases, orbital orientations and pole azimuths are illustrative, not live ephemerides. Earth uses NASA surface and historical cloud composites, not live weather; atmosphere and ocean reflections are approximations. Spheres omit flattening and irregular shapes. Perturbations, eclipses and precession are omitted. Lighting, stars, the solar photosphere and sunspots are illustrative, not live imagery; Galactic travel is a local straight-line illustration with independent scales. Voyager journeys interpolate archived NASA SPKs offline, with matched planet and moon trajectories at flybys. Archive handoffs contain solution differences; this is not live telemetry. Historical images retain dates, processing notes and sources. Beyond 2026 the track is explicitly a constant-velocity illustration, not a precise prediction of stellar encounters or billion-year destinations. Oort Cloud and comet tails are schematic. Music is an original synthesized score.

question.zh: 我一辈子花掉的钱，最后变成了谁的收入？
question.en: Whose income does a lifetime of my spending become?

hook.zh: 一辈子的消费叠成一摞百元钞。抽出一张去吃顿饭：餐馆、农场、电厂一站站往上游，每一站都切走自己的那一份。换一样东西花，钱会走另一条路；再用你的一辈子当尺子，量一量大公司、国防和整个国家的经济。
hook.en: A lifetime of spending becomes a stack of banknotes. Take one out and buy a meal: the restaurant, the farms and the power plants each cut off their share on the way upstream. Spend it on something else and the money takes another road. Then use your lifetime as a ruler for big companies, defense budgets and whole economies.

payoff.zh: 你花出去的每一分钱，最后都成了别人的工资、企业的利润和折旧、政府的税，或者付给了国外。城镇居民每花 100 元，约 6.8 元是藏在价格里的税；不交个税的人，一辈子也会通过买东西交约 19 万元税。
payoff.en: Every cent you spend ends up as someone’s wages, a company’s profit or depreciation, a government’s tax, or a payment abroad. About ¥6.8 of every ¥100 an urban Chinese household spends is tax built into prices, so even people who pay no income tax pay about ¥190,000 in tax over a lifetime.

label.zh: “一辈子”怎么算
label.en: How a lifetime is counted

body.zh: 中国：2025 年城镇居民人均消费支出 35,869 元 × 2025 年人均预期寿命 79.25 岁 ≈ 284 万元。这是按今天的平均水平折算的一生，不是追踪真实的人从出生到老：没有算物价上涨、各年龄花费的差别，也用了全国而不是城镇的预期寿命。消费支出包含自有住房折算租金，不含买房、税费、社保缴款和房贷利息。美国：2024 年每个消费单位支出 78,535 美元，扣除个人保险和养老缴款 9,797 美元、现金赠与 2,292 美元后除以 2.4 人，约 27,700 美元一年；乘以预期寿命 79.0 岁 ≈ 219 万美元。
body.en: China: 2025 urban per-capita consumption of ¥35,869 × 2025 life expectancy of 79.25 years ≈ ¥2.84 million. It is today’s average stretched over a life, not a tracked life course: no inflation, no difference between ages, and national rather than urban life expectancy. Consumption includes imputed rent for owner-occupied homes and excludes home purchases, taxes, social insurance and mortgage interest. United States: 2024 spending of $78,535 per consumer unit, minus $9,797 of insurance and pension contributions and $2,292 of cash gifts, divided by 2.4 people ≈ $27,700 a year; × 79.0 years ≈ $2.19 million.

label.zh: 钞票怎样被一刀刀切开
label.en: How the note is cut

body.zh: 每一刀是投入产出表里的一轮：你付钱的那个行业留下工资、营业盈余（利润、利息和地租等）、固定资产折旧和生产税净额，并为进口原料付钱；剩下的付给国内供应商，进入下一轮。数学上，这是里昂惕夫逆矩阵 (I − A)⁻¹ = I + A + A² + … 的逐项展开，所有轮次加起来正好 100 元。中国用 2023 年表（211 部门），按“各用途进口比例相同”的常用假设拆出进口；美国用 BEA 2025 年 71 行业表和官方进口矩阵，美国表不单列折旧，合称“企业盈余”。
body.en: Each cut is one round of the input-output table: the industry you paid keeps compensation, operating surplus (profit, interest, rent), depreciation and net production taxes, pays for imported inputs, and passes the rest to domestic suppliers. Mathematically it is the Leontief inverse expanded term by term, (I − A)⁻¹ = I + A + A² + …, and the rounds add up to exactly 100. China uses the 2023 table (211 sectors) with the standard assumption that every user imports the same share of a product. The United States uses BEA’s 2025 summary tables (71 industries) and BEA’s import matrix; its gross operating surplus includes depreciation.

label.zh: 税和国防的口径
label.en: What counts as tax and defense

body.zh: “藏在价格里的税”是投入产出表中的生产税净额：增值税、消费税、城建税等减去生产补贴，按城镇居民的消费结构计算约占 6.8%。它不含个人所得税、企业所得税、社保缴款、土地出让收入，海关征收的进口环节税也没有单独拆出，所以是你所交税费的下限。用于国防的部分按 2025 年全国一般公共预算支出中国防占 6.3% 计算，是“如果这笔税按全国预算的比例花掉”的估算；按全国人口平摊，每人一生对应的国防支出约 10 万元。美国的同类税以州和地方的销售税、房产税为主，联邦政府主要靠所得税和工资税，所以不按同样方法折算国防。
body.en: “Tax built into prices” is net taxes on production in the input-output table: VAT, excise and other production taxes minus production subsidies, about 6.8% of urban household spending in China. It excludes income taxes, social insurance, land sales, and customs taxes on imports, so it is a lower bound on what you pay. The defense slice applies the 6.3% defense share of 2025 national general budget spending, an estimate of how that tax would be spent; split per head instead, defense spending is about ¥100,000 per lifetime. In the United States these taxes are mostly state and local sales and property taxes, while Washington relies on income and payroll taxes, so the same defense conversion is not applied.

label.zh: 尺子和比较
label.en: The ruler and the comparisons

body.zh: 每张钞票按 0.1 毫米厚计算（100 张约 1 厘米），各国央行没有公布官方厚度。于是 1 元或 1 美元正好叠 1 微米，一辈子约 2–3 米。公司数据取最近完整财年：腾讯、茅台、中国石化为 2025 年，苹果为 2025 财年，沃尔玛为 2026 财年。营收是卖出去的总额，净利润是扣掉成本和税以后剩下的；市值随股价变化，例如 2026 年 10 月 12 日收盘，贵州茅台约 1.61 万亿元，中国石化（A+H）约 0.62 万亿元。地标高度：哈利法塔 828 米，珠峰 8,849 米，空间站轨道约 400 公里，地球同步轨道 35,786 公里。
body.en: Every note is taken as 0.1 mm thick (100 notes ≈ 1 cm); central banks do not publish an official thickness. One yuan or one dollar therefore stacks to one micrometre, and a lifetime to about 2–3 metres. Company figures use the latest full fiscal year: 2025 for Tencent, Moutai and Sinopec, FY2025 for Apple and FY2026 for Walmart. Revenue is everything sold; net profit is what remains after costs and taxes. Market value moves with the share price: at the 12 October 2026 close, Kweichow Moutai was worth about ¥1.61 trillion and Sinopec (A+H) about ¥0.62 trillion. Landmarks: Burj Khalifa 828 m, Everest 8,849 m, space station orbit about 400 km, geostationary orbit 35,786 km.

label.zh: 简化与边界
label.en: Simplifications

body.zh: 每一样东西都按“全国平均的行业结构”切分，不代表某一家店或某一个品牌。中国的批发零售加价按城镇居民的平均比例（约 17%）加在商品上；美国按各商品的平均流通加价。投入产出表是 2023 年（中国）和 2025 年（美国）的结构，消费金额是 2024–2025 年数据。负数也会出现：农业等环节享受补贴，生产税净额为负；公立医院整体可能亏损，营业盈余为负。美国“平均的一张”按 BEA 个人消费支出（PCE）的结构拆分，其中含雇主和政府代付的医疗等，与 BLS 消费调查的口径不完全相同。图上的每一站只列出收钱最多的三个行业。
body.en: Each purchase is split by national average industry structure, not a particular shop or brand. In China, goods carry the average urban wholesale and retail margin (about 17%); U.S. goods carry their own average distribution margins. Industry structure comes from 2023 (China) and 2025 (United States) tables; spending levels from 2024–2025 data. Negative values occur: subsidies make net production taxes negative in parts of farming, and hospitals can run an operating deficit. The U.S. “average note” follows the BEA personal consumption (PCE) mix, which includes health care paid by employers and government, so it differs from the BLS survey basket. Each stop lists only the three industries receiving the most.

question.zh: 如果飞进水墨，留白里有什么？
question.en: What lies in the empty space of an ink landscape?

hook.zh: 掠过渔舟、穿桥入巷，再升入群山，回望整幅松溪。
hook.en: Sweep over a fishing boat, through bridges and village lanes, then rise into the mountains and look back over Songxi.

payoff.zh: 亲手飞过松亭与村巷，或跟随一镜到底的航线，随时转向探索自己的山水。
payoff.en: Fly through pavilions and village lanes yourself, or follow a continuous tour and take the controls whenever you like.

label.zh: 原创空间
label.en: An original space

body.zh: 这是一幅以三维几何、原创皴笔纹理和程序笔触创作的水墨山水，不复原某一幅古画，也不代表真实地形。浓淡、遮挡和留白借鉴水墨绘画的空间表达。以原创母画《松溪入画》为基准，松亭、水道、桥洞、村落和前后层叠的山峰处于同一三维空间。原画视角以外的空间由创作补全，山峰为可接近的实体，树叶采用分布于三维枝干上的绘画片层。飞行采用 22.8 秒编排航线，末段从中低视点回望层叠山水；自由漫游是简化控制，允许穿过山体，不是无人机物理模拟。
body.en: This original ink landscape uses three-dimensional geometry, original ink textures and procedural marks. It does not reconstruct a historical painting or a real terrain. Ink values, occlusion and empty space draw on landscape painting practices. Based on the original painting Songxi: Into the Ink, the pavilion, river, arch bridge, village and overlapping mountain ranges share one three-dimensional space. Areas beyond the painting’s viewpoint are creative additions. The peaks are approachable volumes; painted foliage cards are distributed along three-dimensional branches. The 22.8-second flight follows an authored path with a low climbing return and a layered landscape finish; free roaming uses simplified controls and permits passing through terrain, rather than simulating drone physics.

payoff.zh: 沿连续航线穿越画中的想象空间，随时接管飞行，点亮村庄，再对照梵高的原作。
payoff.en: Follow a continuous flight, take the controls, light the village and compare this imagined space with Van Gogh’s original.

label.zh: 艺术化边界
label.en: Interpretation

body.zh: 绘画只给出一个视角。柏树旁的木屋、建筑背面、街巷、河桥和可进入的天空是创作延伸。24 秒航线使用编排的镜头；自由飞行采用简化控制，允许穿过建筑，不是无人机物理模拟、原作扫描或历史实景复原。原作可随时打开对照。
body.en: A painting supplies one viewpoint. The timber lookout, unseen architecture, lanes, river bridge and enterable sky are imagined additions. The 24-second flight is an authored camera path; free flight uses simplified controls and permits passing through buildings. This is not a drone physics simulation, a scan or a historical reconstruction. The original is available for comparison.

question.zh: 一件 T 恤背后，谁在劳动、谁先垫钱，谁最后留下多少？
question.en: Who works, who advances the money, and who keeps what behind one T-shirt?

hook.zh: 一件百元 T 恤连接棉田、纺织厂、制衣厂、商店、家庭和银行。打开工厂比较不同岗位的人均工资与总额，改变工资、出厂价和账期，观察利润、欠款与建楼资金同时变化。
hook.en: A ¥100 T-shirt connects cotton farms, textile mills, garment factories, shops, households and banks. Compare pay per person and total payroll, then change wages, factory prices and payment terms to see profits, debt and building funds respond together.

payoff.zh: 同一笔采购是买方成本，也是供应商收入。工资总额取决于人数与月薪；利润、账户现金、股东分红和厂房资产各有不同含义。
payoff.en: One buyer’s purchase is a supplier’s revenue. Payroll depends on both headcount and pay; profit, bank cash, shareholder dividends and factory buildings mean different things.

label.zh: 所有金额均为教学假设
label.en: All amounts are teaching assumptions

body.zh: 一个生产月、10 万件 T 恤。制衣厂 91 人，纺织厂 65 人；工资、成本、价格、账期与股权均为假设，不是任何真实公司或行业均值。资料支持会计概念和产业关系，不为这些金额背书。
body.en: One production month and 100,000 shirts. The garment factory has 91 people and the textile mill 65. Wages, costs, prices, terms and ownership are hypothetical, not company data or industry averages. Sources support concepts and relationships, not these amounts.

label.zh: 利润与现金分别计算
label.en: Profit and cash are calculated separately

body.en: Both factories include wages, assumed employer benefits of 20% of wages, depreciation, and assumed tax of 25% on positive pretax profit. question.zh: 实数里的正弦波有界，到了复数里为什么越长越高？
question.en: Why does a bounded sine wave grow without bound when its input becomes complex?

hook.zh: 一条熟悉的函数曲线沿虚数方向展开，变成可以转动的彩色线网。正弦的波峰向两侧升高，指数的一侧平缓、一侧陡峭，倒数在原点附近急剧起伏。切换实部、虚部与模长，看同一个复数结果的不同侧面。
hook.en: A familiar curve unfolds along the imaginary direction into a colored mesh you can rotate. Sine grows taller on both sides, the exponential rises steeply on one side, and the reciprocal bends sharply near the origin. Switch between real part, imaginary part and magnitude to see different aspects of the same complex output.

payoff.zh: 复变函数的输入和输出都各有两个实数分量，因此完整图像需要四个实数维度。这里用底面的两个方向表示输入 z=x+iy，高度选择输出的实部、虚部或模长，色相表示输出的辐角。正弦函数的实部是 sin(x)cosh(y)：在 y=0 时就是普通正弦波，离开实数轴后，cosh(y) 让波峰和波谷同时放大。平面映射模式则把输入网格逐点送到输出位置；例如 e^z 把竖线变成圆、横线变成射线。
payoff.en: A complex function has two real input coordinates and two real output coordinates, so its full graph needs four real dimensions. Here the base represents the input z=x+iy, height shows the real part, imaginary part or magnitude of the output, and hue shows its argument. The real part of sine is sin(x)cosh(y): at y=0 it is the familiar sine wave, while cosh(y) amplifies its peaks and valleys away from the real axis. Plane mapping instead moves each input grid point to its output position: e^z maps vertical lines to circles and horizontal lines to rays.

question.zh: 一串旋转的圆，为什么能画出任何曲线？
question.en: Why can a series of rotating circles draw any curves?

hook.zh: 每个圆是一个正弦分量，首尾相接就能叠加出任意周期曲线。调项数、换波形、甚至手绘一条曲线看它现场分解。
hook.en: Each circle is a sinusoidal component, and any periodic curve can be superimposed end to end. Adjust the number of terms, change the waveform, and even draw a curve by hand to see it decompose on the spot.

payoff.zh: 傅里叶级数：任何周期信号都能分解为整数倍频率的正弦波之和。项数越多越逼近，但跳变处约 9% 的吉布斯过冲永远不会消失。
payoff.en: Fourier series: Any periodic signal can be decomposed into the sum of sine waves with integer multiples of frequency. The approximation gets better with more terms, but the ~9% Gibbs overshoot at the jump never goes away.

question.zh: 桌上有一根针要掉头，最少需要多大一块地方？
question.en: A needle on a table needs to turn around — how little room does it need?

hook.zh: 先观察一根针移动和转向时扫过的区域，再想一想：如果每个方向都要放得下一根针，会有什么限制？
hook.en: Watch the region swept out as a needle moves and turns. Then ask what changes if a set must contain a needle pointing in every direction.

payoff.zh: 这里把针理想化成没有宽度的单位线段。包含每个方向的一条单位线段的集合叫挂谷集，但面积、体积与维数是不同的量。Wang 与 Zahl 的三维结果说明这类集合的豪斯多夫维数和闵可夫斯基维数都为 3，并不意味着体积必须大于零。本世界的二维演示帮助理解问题，不是三维证明。
payoff.en: The needle is an ideal unit line segment with no thickness. A Kakeya set contains such a segment in every direction, but area, volume and dimension are different quantities. Wang and Zahl’s three-dimensional result establishes Hausdorff and Minkowski dimension 3, not a positive lower bound on volume. This two-dimensional illustration introduces the question; it does not demonstrate the three-dimensional proof.

question.zh: 为什么一个公式的边界，越放大越看不完？
question.en: Why does one formula’s boundary never run out as you zoom?

hook.zh: 每个像素代表一个复数 c。从零开始反复计算 z²+c，彩色记录逃逸所需的次数，黑色是在计算上限内仍未逃逸的点。沿着边界放大，螺旋与分支层层展开。
hook.en: Each pixel represents a complex number c. Starting at zero, repeat z²+c. Color records the iterations before escape; black means no escape was observed within the iteration limit. Zoom along the boundary to reveal nested spirals and branches.

payoff.zh: 曼德勃罗集的边界具有无限细节，本体验以有限精度和最多 1600 次迭代近似绘制，缩放上限为一百万倍；黑色不等于已证明属于集合。颜色是循环配色，不表示越亮逃逸越快。切换 Julia 集，会固定 c 并改变每个像素的起点；播放时 c 沿圆周缓慢变化。
payoff.en: The mathematical boundary has infinite detail. This finite-precision approximation uses up to 1,600 iterations and limits zoom to one million times; black is not proof of membership. Colors cycle, so brighter does not mean faster escape. Julia mode fixes c and varies the starting point across pixels; playback moves c slowly around a circle.

question.zh: 不规则的素数间距，能被另一种数学结构描述吗？
question.en: Can another mathematical structure describe the uneven gaps between primes?

hook.zh: 金色素数光珠展开成阶梯，紫色零点波一层层加入。看见黎曼猜想连接的两件事。
hook.en: Golden prime pearls unfold into a staircase as violet zero waves join it. See the two sides of the Riemann hypothesis.

payoff.zh: 黎曼猜想断言 ζ 函数的全部非平凡零点都在实部 1/2 的直线上。它关系到素数偏离平均分布的幅度；有限计算不等于证明。
payoff.en: The Riemann hypothesis says that every nontrivial zero of the zeta function has real part 1/2. It concerns fluctuations in prime distribution; finite computation is not a proof.

label.zh: 画面怎么算
label.en: What is computed

body.zh: 素数用筛法精确枚举。加权计数 ψ(x) 在每个素数幂 pᵏ 处增加 ln p；画面画出 ψ(x)−x，不能把它当作普通素数计数 π(x)。
body.en: Primes are enumerated by an exact sieve. The weighted count ψ(x) increases by ln p at each prime power pᵏ. The plotted quantity is ψ(x)−x, not the ordinary prime count π(x).

label.zh: 零点与近似
label.en: Zeros and approximation

body.zh: 紫色曲线使用前 20 对数值零点代入显式公式：ψ(x)≈x−Σρ x^ρ/ρ−ln(2π)−½ln(1−x⁻²)。共轭零点成对求和；跳点处公式取左右极限的平均，有限截断会振铃。零点坐标保留约 12 位小数。
body.en: Violet curves use the first 20 numerical conjugate zero pairs in the explicit formula ψ(x)≈x−Σρ x^ρ/ρ−ln(2π)−½ln(1−x⁻²). At jumps the formula takes the mean of the two limits; finite truncation causes ringing. Zero coordinates are rounded to about 12 decimal places.

label.zh: 空间与时间
label.en: Space and time

body.zh: 开场螺旋只是把整数数轴盘起来，并不表示素数存在螺旋定律。波的前后层次只为分开不同部分和。时间轴控制确定的叙事画面；暂停会冻结全部运动。
body.en: The opening spiral is a coiled integer number line, not a spiral law for primes. Depth separates partial sums. The timeline reconstructs a deterministic narrative frame; pausing freezes all motion.

label.zh: 证明的边界
label.en: What remains open

body.zh: 截至本次制作核对，克雷数学研究所仍将黎曼猜想列为未解决。已知零点支持猜想，但任何有限清单都不能代替覆盖所有非平凡零点的证明。
body.en: At the source check for this world, the Clay Mathematics Institute still lists the Riemann hypothesis as unsolved. Known zeros support it, but a finite list cannot establish a claim about every nontrivial zero.

question.zh: 同样四根弦，为什么按在不同的格上，就弹出不同的音？
question.en: Why does pressing a different fret make the same string play a different note?

hook.zh: 从琴的正上方看一把尤克里里自己弹歌：手指按在哪一格，弦上亮着的那一段就剩多长。
hook.en: Watch a ukulele play itself from directly above. Wherever a finger presses, the glowing part of the string is the part that can still vibrate.

payoff.zh: 弦越短，音越高。每按高一格，能振动的那段弦缩短到前一格的 0.944（约 5.6%），音高升一个半音；所以琴格越靠近琴身越密，第 12 格正好把弦分成两半，音高升一个八度。
payoff.en: A shorter string sounds higher. Each fret leaves 0.944 of the vibrating length (5.6% shorter) and raises the note by a semitone, so frets crowd together toward the body, and the 12th fret splits the string in half: one octave up.

label.zh: 琴格为什么越来越密
label.en: Why the frets crowd together

body.zh: 十二平均律把一个八度分成 12 个相等的半音，相邻半音的频率比是 2 的 12 次方根。弦能振动的长度和音高成反比，所以每按高一格，这段长度就变成前一格的 2^(−1/12) ≈ 0.9439 倍，也就是短 5.6%。第 n 格离琴枕的距离是 d = s − s / 2^(n/12)，s 是弦长；第一格是 s 的 1/17.817，此后每一格的间距都是前一格的 0.9439 倍。第 12 格落在弦长一半处，正好高一个八度。这里的 15 个琴格按这个公式放置，弦长取 38 cm（音乐会尺寸）。
body.en: Twelve-tone equal temperament splits the octave into 12 equal semitones, each a frequency ratio of the twelfth root of two. Pitch is inversely proportional to the length of string free to vibrate, so each higher fret leaves 2^(−1/12) ≈ 0.9439 of the previous length, which is 5.6% shorter. Fret n sits at d = s − s / 2^(n/12) from the nut, where s is the scale length; the first fret is s / 17.817 from the nut, and every later gap is 0.9439 times the one before. The 12th fret falls at half the scale length: exactly one octave up. The 15 frets here follow this formula on a 38 cm (concert) scale.

label.zh: 弦只是起点，声音靠琴身
label.en: The string starts it; the body makes the sound

body.zh: 一根弦又细又轻，在空气里几乎推不动什么，自己几乎不出声。弦的振动经琴桥传给面板，再由面板和琴腔里的空气带动周围的空气，才有了能听见的音量和木头的音色。吉他的研究把这个过程讲得最清楚，尤克里里的原理相同。
body.en: A string is thin and light and moves almost no air, so on its own it makes hardly any sound. Its vibration passes through the bridge to the top plate, and the plate and the air inside the body move the air around them; that is where the loudness and the woody colour come from. Guitar research describes this best, and the ukulele works the same way.

label.zh: 回旋定弦
label.en: Re-entrant tuning

body.zh: 常见的尤克里里定弦是 G4–C4–E4–A4：第四弦的 G 比第三弦的 C 还高，这叫回旋定弦。四根空弦的音都落在 C4 到 A4 这九个半音之内，所以和弦里的音挨得很近。
body.en: The common ukulele tuning is G4–C4–E4–A4. The fourth-string G sits above the third-string C, which is called re-entrant tuning. All four open strings fall within the nine semitones from C4 to A4, so the notes of a chord lie very close together.

label.zh: 哪些是真的，哪些放慢或简化了
label.en: What is real, and what is slowed or simplified

body.zh: 琴格位置、定弦和各格的音高按真实尺寸与平均律计算。声音是程序合成的：每个音由一组逐渐衰减的泛音叠成，再经过一组调过的琴身共振，不是录音，也不是某把琴的实测响应。弦的振动被放慢了约 100 到 200 倍才看得清（真实的 A 弦每秒振动 440 次，画面里每秒摆动 2 到 5 次），幅度也略有夸大；沿弦来回的光点示意拨弦产生的两个波被两端反射，它的速度只为看清而取。真实乐器会把琴桥略微后移来校准音准，这里的琴格按理想公式摆放。手指画成光点，不是手的模型。伴奏和指法由程序编排。
body.en: Fret positions, the tuning and the pitch at every fret are computed from real dimensions and equal temperament. The sound is synthesised: each note is a stack of decaying overtones passed through a set of tuned body resonances. It is not a recording, nor the measured response of any particular instrument. The string’s motion is slowed by roughly 100 to 200 times so it can be seen (a real A string vibrates 440 times a second; here it swings 2 to 5 times a second), and its size is slightly exaggerated. The light travelling along the string stands for the two waves a pluck sends out and the end reflections; its speed was chosen to be readable. Real instruments shift the saddle slightly to correct intonation; the frets here follow the ideal formula. Fingers are drawn as points of light, not as a model of a hand. The accompaniment and fingering are arranged by a program.

label.zh: 曲子与乐谱
label.en: The songs and their scores

body.zh: 五首曲子都是公版：卡农（帕赫贝尔）、绿袖子（英格兰民谣）、献给爱丽丝（贝多芬）、茉莉花（中国民歌，据记载清乾隆年间已流传）、送别（奥德韦曲，李叔同填词）。旋律的音高和节奏对照公版乐谱与公开 MIDI 逐音核对，并移到尤克里里弹得出的音域；伴奏与指法由程序编排，所以这是一份自动编排的演奏，不是某位演奏者的录音。导入的 MIDI 只在你的浏览器里处理，不会上传。
body.en: All five songs are in the public domain: Canon (Pachelbel), Greensleeves (English folk tune), Für Elise (Beethoven), Jasmine Flower (Chinese folk song, recorded as already in circulation in the Qianlong era) and Songbie (tune by Ordway, words by Li Shutong). Melody pitches and rhythms were checked note by note against public-domain scores and open MIDI files, then moved into a range a ukulele can play. The accompaniment and fingering are arranged by a program, so this is an automatic arrangement, not a recording of a player. A MIDI file you import is processed in your browser and never uploaded.

question.zh: 几乎相同的起点，为什么走出完全不同的未来？
question.en: Why do nearly identical starts lead to completely different futures?

hook.zh: 两个光点从相差 0.000001 出发，沿同一组混沌方程飞行；几十秒后它们飞向蝴蝶不同的翅膀，对数仪表记下这场撕裂。
hook.en: Two lights set off 0.000001 apart along the same chaotic equations; seconds later they fly to opposite wings of the butterfly while a logarithmic meter records the tear.

payoff.zh: 规则完全确定，长期却不可预测：微小差别被指数放大。这就是蝴蝶效应，也是天气预报报不准两周后的原理极限。
payoff.en: Fully deterministic rules, yet unpredictable long-term: tiny differences grow exponentially. That is the butterfly effect—and the principled limit of two-week weather forecasts.

hook.zh: 拖一下，染料会被水流带走，在快慢交界处卷成漩涡；把液体调得更黏，细小旋转又会更快消失。
hook.en: Drag once: the flow carries the dye away, curls it into vortices where fast and slow layers meet, then loses the smallest swirls faster when the liquid is more viscous.

payoff.zh: 水流会把原有速度继续带向前，快慢不同的相邻水层会彼此卷起，黏性再把这些速度差慢慢抹平。纳维－斯托克斯方程把这三件事写在了一起。
payoff.en: A flow carries its existing velocity forward, neighboring layers moving at different speeds roll around each other, and viscosity gradually smooths that difference away. The Navier–Stokes equations describe all three.

question.zh: 如果追着光飞，为什么测得的光速不变？这与时间和空间有什么关系？
question.en: Why does chasing light leave its measured speed unchanged? What does that have to do with space and time?

hook.zh: 先用一把尺、一只钟量小球的速度，再坐上飞船追光。看光在移动的镜子间走出斜线，发现时间为什么改变，再把一次闪光的历史叠成光锥。七分钟，从日常直觉走进时空。
hook.en: Start with a ruler, a clock, and a moving ball. Then board a ship and chase light. Watch its diagonal path between moving mirrors reveal a difference in time, and stack a flash’s history into a light cone. Seven minutes from everyday intuition to spacetime.

payoff.zh: 真空光速 c 把时间与空间联系起来。不同惯性观察者可以对距离、时长与同时性有不同测量，却同意光速与因果边界。光子没有静止参考系；时空是否在更小尺度上离散，仍是未解决的问题。
payoff.en: The vacuum speed of light, c, connects space and time. Inertial observers can disagree on distances, durations, and simultaneity while agreeing on light speed and causal boundaries. Photons have no rest frame. Whether spacetime is discrete at smaller scales remains an open question.

label.zh: 光为什么不用一直被推
label.en: Why light needs no continuing push

body.zh: 汽车要持续供能，通常是为了抵消阻力。在惯性系中，无合外力的有质量物体也会保持匀速直线运动。光是电磁场的传播；光子是这个场的量子激发。真空中的自由光子以 c 传播，无需先从静止加速。零静止质量不等于没有能量或动量。
body.en: A car usually needs continued power to counter resistance. In an inertial frame, a massive object with no net external force also maintains constant velocity. Light propagates as an electromagnetic field; photons are its quantum excitations. A free photon in vacuum travels at c without first accelerating from rest. Zero rest mass does not mean zero energy or momentum.

label.zh: 为什么偏偏是这个数
label.en: Why this particular number?

body.zh: c = 299,792,458 m/s 在国际单位制中是精确值，因为米用光在真空中传播的距离来定义。换成光秒与秒，c 就是 1 光秒/秒。真正的物理发现是：不同惯性观察者用各自的钟和尺测量，得到同一个真空光速。单位定义并不解释这条规律为什么成立，也没有给出自然为何选择这些规律的终极答案。
body.en: In SI units, c = 299,792,458 m/s is exact because the meter is defined using light’s travel in vacuum. In light-seconds and seconds, c is 1 light-second per second. The physical discovery is that inertial observers using their own clocks and rulers obtain the same vacuum light speed. Defining a unit does not explain that invariance or why nature follows these laws.

label.zh: 从光钟到时间
label.en: From a light clock to time

body.zh: 两镜之间一次完整往返算一拍。镜距垂直于飞船运动方向，在两个惯性系中相同。地面系中，移动镜面让光走斜线；路更长而速度仍为 c，每一拍便更久：Δτ = Δt√(1 − v²/c²)。图中把镜距定为 3 光秒，v = 0.8c 时，半程镜面侧移 4 光秒、光走 5 光秒；船上经过 3 秒，地面经过 5 秒。完整一拍是地面 10 秒、船上 6 秒。这里采用船上同步钟的坐标时间，不是光子自身时间。飞船上的人和自己的钟都照常运行；换到飞船系比较，地面钟也较慢，因为两种比较选取的远处同时事件不同。
body.en: One complete trip between the mirrors and back is one tick. The mirror separation is perpendicular to the ship’s motion and is the same in both frames. In the ground frame, moving mirrors make light take a diagonal. The longer path at unchanged speed c takes more time: Δτ = Δt√(1 − v²/c²). With a 3-light-second mirror spacing and speed 0.8c, one leg has 4 light-seconds of sideways motion and 5 of light travel: 3 seconds in the clock frame and 5 in the ground frame. A full tick takes 6 and 10 seconds. The clock-frame duration uses synchronized coordinate clocks, not a photon’s own time. People and clocks aboard run normally. The ship frame measures the ground clock as slower, using a different set of distant simultaneous events.

label.zh: 时空里什么保持不变
label.en: What stays unchanged in spacetime?

body.zh: 在平直时空的一维运动中，两个事件的间隔 (cΔt)² − Δx² 不随惯性系改变。洛伦兹变换同时改变时间和空间坐标，速度因此不能简单相减：u′ = (u − v)/(1 − uv/c²)。代入 u = c，仍得到 c。未经立体投影的 x–ct 截面里，光线为 45°，因为两轴使用同样尺度；屏幕上的角度还受观察角度影响。光锥标出一个事件能影响或能受影响的事件范围；锥外某个事件不可达，不表示那个地点永远不可抵达。
body.en: For one-dimensional motion in flat spacetime, (cΔt)² − Δx² between two events is invariant. Lorentz transformations change both spatial and temporal coordinates, giving u′ = (u − v)/(1 − uv/c²). Setting u = c still gives c. In an unprojected x–ct section, light lies at 45° because the axes use equal scales; the on-screen angle also depends on the view. A light cone marks events that can influence, or be influenced by, its origin. An unreachable event outside it does not mean that location is forever unreachable.

label.zh: 零间隔不是同一个事件
label.en: A zero interval does not merge events

body.zh: 光在真空中的世界线是零间隔。发射和吸收仍是两个事件，普通观察者能测到它们之间的传播时间。光子没有静止参考系，不能给它安置一个同速观察者或自身时钟。因此“光子眼里时间停止”“出生和消亡是同一瞬间”都不是这里采用的物理结论。
body.en: A light ray in vacuum follows a null worldline. Emission and absorption are still distinct events, separated by a travel time measured by ordinary observers. A photon has no rest frame, so it cannot carry a comoving observer or clock. “Time stops for the photon” and “birth and death happen at the same instant” are not physical conclusions used here.

label.zh: 为什么有质量的物体到不了 c
label.en: Why massive objects cannot reach c

body.zh: 总能量和动量满足 E² = p²c² + m²c⁴。固定的非零静止质量 m 对应 E = γmc²，γ = 1/√(1 − v²/c²)；速度逼近 c，所需能量无界增长。光子的 m = 0，却有 E = pc = hf。更高频率意味着更多能量，不意味着真空中更快。这里不把质量叫作“时间税”，也不把四维时空当作可分配的普通速度预算。
body.en: Energy and momentum satisfy E² = p²c² + m²c⁴. For fixed nonzero rest mass m, E = γmc² with γ = 1/√(1 − v²/c²). Required energy grows without bound as speed approaches c. A photon has m = 0 but E = pc = hf. Higher frequency means more energy, not faster travel in vacuum. Mass is not a “time tax,” and spacetime is not modeled as an ordinary speed budget.

label.zh: 玻璃里的光为什么慢下来
label.en: Why light travels more slowly in glass

body.zh: 入射电场驱动材料中的电荷，电荷产生的响应场与原场相干叠加，改变相位传播。这不是光子在每个原子处停下、吸收、再发射的接力。折射率 n 给出相速度 c/n。本世界只演示理想透明、无吸收且无色散的介质，此时脉冲包络与波峰同速。省略界面反射和透射振幅修正，电荷位移被放大，不模拟界面能流。真实介质的相速度、群速度和信号传播需要区分。
body.en: The incident electric field drives charges in a material. Their response adds coherently to the incident field, changing phase propagation. Light does not repeatedly stop at each atom for absorption and re-emission. The phase speed is c/n. This world assumes a transparent, lossless, nondispersive material, so the pulse envelope and crests travel together. Interface reflections and transmission-amplitude corrections are omitted, and charge displacements are enlarged; interface energy flux is not modeled. Real materials require distinctions between phase, group, and signal propagation.

label.zh: 量子路径说的是怎样计算
label.en: What quantum paths describe

body.zh: 量子理论用概率幅预测探测结果。不可区分的通路先叠加概率幅，再取模平方；可区分的路径记录会改变干涉。路径积分对不同历史的振幅求和，“光子真的同时跑遍每条路”是超出实验直接结论的说法。本世界的亮点与光线是传播示意，不追踪一个光子的隐含真实轨迹，也不模拟双缝测量。
body.en: Quantum theory predicts detections using probability amplitudes. Indistinguishable alternatives are added before taking the squared magnitude; distinguishable path records change interference. A path integral sums amplitudes over histories. Saying a photon literally travels every route goes beyond what experiments directly establish. The luminous points and rays here illustrate propagation, not hidden photon trajectories or a simulated double-slit measurement.

label.zh: 时空有像素吗
label.en: Does spacetime have pixels?

body.zh: 广义相对论采用连续时空。圈量子引力等候选理论研究离散的量子几何，但离散时空尚未得到实验证实，也不必是一排规则小方格。天文观测能限制某些会让光传播出现额外变化的模型；排除一种模型不等于证明绝对连续。普朗克尺度不是已经测出的宇宙像素。本世界中的网格只表示坐标，放大它不会发现真实的时空颗粒。
body.en: General relativity uses continuous spacetime. Candidates such as loop quantum gravity investigate discrete quantum geometry, but spacetime discreteness has not been experimentally established and need not resemble a regular grid. Astronomy constrains some models that alter light propagation; rejecting one model does not prove perfect continuity. The Planck scale is not a measured cosmic pixel size. The grid here represents coordinates, not physical grains revealed by zooming in.

label.zh: 钟真的会这样走吗
label.en: Do real clocks behave this way?

body.zh: 原子钟实验测到了运动与引力造成的钟速差异。GPS 卫星钟相对地面每天受运动效应影响约慢 7 微秒，较弱引力效应约快 45 微秒，合计约快 38 微秒，因此必须修正。不能笼统地说飞上天的钟总会更慢。主动画聚焦狭义相对论，未把 GPS 的引力修正加入光钟。
body.en: Atomic-clock experiments have measured rate differences caused by motion and gravity. Relative to clocks on Earth, motion makes GPS clocks about 7 microseconds slower per day, while weaker gravity makes them about 45 microseconds faster: a net gain of about 38 microseconds that must be corrected. Airborne clocks are not always slower. The main animation uses special relativity and does not add GPS gravitational corrections to the light clock.

label.zh: 画面与模型的边界
label.en: Visual and model boundaries

body.zh: 镜面、光带和场振动被放大，传播被放慢，颜色与亮度用于辨认对象。光锥表面的材质只为看清几何边界，并无实体薄膜。波形的起伏表示场强，不是光子蛇形运动。相对论场景采用平直时空与理想惯性系，调速选择一个新的匀速条件，最高 0.98c；不模拟真实加速旅程、引力或黑洞。图中事件与读数是坐标测量，未计算光到眼睛的延迟、相对论视觉畸变或多普勒颜色。场景之间的连续变形用于解释，不是同一束真实光的完整旅程。数值来自理论模型，未导入实测数据。
body.en: Mirrors, light ribbons, and field oscillations are enlarged; propagation is slowed, with color and brightness distinguishing objects. The light cone’s surface material makes its geometric boundary visible; it is not a physical membrane. Wave height represents field strength, not a photon weaving through space. Relativistic scenes use flat spacetime and ideal inertial frames. Adjusting speed selects a new constant-velocity condition, up to 0.98c; acceleration histories, gravity, and black holes are omitted. Events and readouts are coordinate measurements, without light-travel delay to the eye, relativistic visual distortion, or Doppler color. Scene morphs explain relationships rather than one real pulse’s complete journey. Readings are theoretical, not imported measurements.

question.zh: 光子怎样遵循波的规律，又被一颗颗探测到？光速不变，为什么运动的钟会变慢？
question.en: How can photons follow wave rules yet arrive one at a time? If light keeps the same speed, why does a moving clock run slower?

hook.zh: 光点在探测屏上积成条纹。两缝都开着，只增加路径记录，新的曝光就失去干涉条纹。让红蓝脉冲同时出发，再切换地面与飞船参考系，观察光子的能量、真空光速与钟的节拍。
hook.en: Dots build up into stripes on the detector. Keep both slits open but add path records, and a new exposure loses its interference stripes. Send red and blue pulses together, then switch between ground and ship frames to explore photon energy, light speed in vacuum, and the ticking of clocks.

payoff.zh: 光子是电磁场的一份量子激发。探测是离散的，落点分布取决于概率幅与路径是否可区分。蓝光的每个光子能量更高，红蓝光在真空中同速。每个惯性观察者都测得运动钟较慢，自己的钟则照常走；光子没有静止参考系。
payoff.en: A photon is one quantum excitation of the electromagnetic field. Detections are discrete; their distribution depends on probability amplitudes and whether the paths can be distinguished. Blue photons carry more energy, while red and blue light travel equally fast in vacuum. Each inertial observer measures moving clocks as slower while their own clock runs normally. A photon has no rest frame.

topicLabel.en: Photons and the speed of light

label.zh: 一颗光子与一片波
label.en: One photon and a wave pattern

body.zh: 光子是电磁场的一份量子激发。一次探测留下一个局部事件。两缝开放、通路保持相干且没有可区分的路径记录时，先把两条可能性的概率幅相加，再取模平方：P ∝ |ψ₁ + ψ₂|²。多次同样准备的光子探测积成干涉条纹。场中的光带示意相位与概率幅，不能当作单个光子的行进路径。
body.en: A photon is one quantum excitation of the electromagnetic field. Each detection is a localized event. When both slits are open, the paths remain coherent, and no distinguishable path record exists, add their probability amplitudes before taking the squared magnitude: P ∝ |ψ₁ + ψ₂|². Many photons prepared in the same way build an interference pattern. The luminous bands illustrate phase and probability amplitude; they do not trace an individual photon’s path.

label.zh: 路径记录为什么改变条纹
label.en: Why path records change the pattern

body.zh: 开启偏振标记后，两条通路关联夹角为 θ 的线偏振态。理想等强通路的干涉项乘以 cos θ：0° 时标记相同，90° 时正交且可完全区分，中间角度只部分可区分。这里 V = cos θ 表示去除单缝包络后的理想条纹可见度。这里的标记器理想化为不吸收光子，两条缝仍开放。在 90° 时，只统计屏上落点、忽略标记，概率相加：P ∝ |ψ₁|² + |ψ₂|²。两缝之间的干涉消失，各缝的衍射包络仍在。缝旁圆环中的线段表示偏振方向；只有 90° 时用青色、琥珀色落点示意可区分的记录，中间角度不为单次落点指定路径。标记不改变当前波长，默认 520 nm。记录是否被人读取不改变结果，人的意识不参与模型。调节标记会开始新曝光，前次已积累的分布以虚线保留，各分布按自身峰值缩放；已经落下的点不会被改写。这里不演示量子擦除。
body.en: Enabling polarization marks associates the paths with linear polarization states separated by θ. For ideal equal-strength paths, the interference term is multiplied by cos θ: at 0° the markers are identical, at 90° they are orthogonal and fully distinguishable, and intermediate angles give partial distinguishability. V = cos θ is the ideal fringe visibility after removing the single-slit envelope. The ideal markers do not absorb photons, and both slits remain open. At 90°, counting screen detections without resolving the markers means adding probabilities: P ∝ |ψ₁|² + |ψ₂|². Interference between the slits disappears, while each slit’s diffraction envelope remains. Lines inside the slit rings show polarization directions. Only at 90° do cyan and amber dots illustrate distinguishable records; individual detections at intermediate angles are not assigned a path. The markers do not change the current wavelength, which defaults to 520 nm. No one needs to read the record; human awareness has no role in the model. Changing the markers starts a new exposure and preserves the last accumulated distribution as a dashed comparison, each distribution scaled to its own peak. Earlier detections are never rewritten. Quantum erasure is not modeled.

label.zh: 双缝模型与曝光
label.en: The double-slit model and exposure

body.zh: 模型采用两缝间相干的理想单色单光子、等宽平行狭缝和远场衍射近似。默认波长 520 nm、缝距 0.30 mm、缝宽 0.06 mm、屏距 2 m；探测屏显示中心左右各 16 mm。落点按这个范围内归一化的概率分布抽样，不模拟遮缝和标记器的透过率、探测效率或背景噪声。已记录的点保持原位；改变波长、缝距、遮缝或路径记录状态会开始新曝光，前次积累的分布保留为对照。逐个与连续曝光的每次落点均从当前分布独立抽样，均为模拟结果。
body.en: The model uses ideal monochromatic single photons coherent across two equal parallel slits, with the far-field diffraction approximation. Defaults are a 520 nm wavelength, 0.30 mm slit separation, 0.06 mm slit width, and a screen 2 m away. The displayed screen extends 16 mm on either side of its center. Detections are sampled from the distribution normalized within that window. Slit and marker transmission losses, detector efficiency, and background noise are omitted. Recorded dots stay in place. Changing wavelength, slit separation, slit coverage, or path recording starts a new exposure while retaining the previous accumulated distribution for comparison. Each detection in single or continuous exposure is sampled independently from the current distribution. These are simulated results.

label.zh: 颜色、能量与光速
label.en: Color, energy, and speed

body.zh: 单色视图可调 400–700 nm，满足 f = c/λ、E = hf。波长越短，频率与每光子能量越高；同一颜色变亮，增加的是单位时间内的光子数。红蓝比较使用中心波长为 650 nm 和 450 nm 的窄带脉冲，同时发出并走过相同真空距离。有限脉冲有一定频谱宽度，能量读数用中心波长近似每光子的能量。真空中波峰与脉冲包络都以 c = 299,792,458 m/s 传播。电磁波形示意场值的空间起伏，不能看成光子的外形；屏幕颜色近似表示光谱色调。
body.en: The single-color view spans 400–700 nm, with f = c/λ and E = hf. Shorter wavelengths mean higher frequency and more energy per photon. Brighter light at a fixed color means more photons per unit time. The red–blue comparison uses narrowband pulses centered on 650 and 450 nm, emitted together over equal distances in vacuum. A finite pulse has a spread of frequencies; the energy readout uses its central wavelength to approximate the energy per photon. Both crests and pulse envelopes travel through vacuum at c = 299,792,458 m/s. The waveform illustrates spatial variation in the field, not a photon’s shape. Screen colors approximate spectral hues.

label.zh: 光钟怎样计时
label.en: How the light clocks measure time

body.zh: 青绿色始终表示地面钟，琥珀色始终表示飞船钟；颜色只区分身份，不表示频移。光回到出发镜面、完成一次往返，才计一次滴答。选定地面或飞船惯性参考系后，两只钟按该参考系的同一时刻比较。相对速度为 β = v/c；静止钟经过时间 t，相对运动的钟积累自身时间 τ = t√(1 − β²)。运动钟里的光走更长的斜线，速度仍为 c，所以完整往返更久。读数随模拟进度更新，未加入光传播到眼前的延迟。例如在地面系中，飞船速度为 0.8c，地面经过 10 秒，飞船钟积累 6 秒。
body.en: Cyan-green always identifies the ground clock; amber identifies the ship clock. These colors encode identity, not a frequency shift. One tick is counted when light returns to its starting mirror after a full round trip. In either the ground or ship inertial frame, the clocks are compared at the same time in that frame. Their relative speed is β = v/c. During time t on the stationary clock, the moving clock accumulates proper time τ = t√(1 − β²). Its light follows a longer diagonal at the same speed c, so each round trip takes longer. Readouts advance with the simulation, without the delay for light to reach an observer’s eyes. For example, in the ground frame at 0.8c, the ship clock accumulates 6 seconds during 10 ground seconds.

label.zh: 参考系与同时
label.en: Reference frames and simultaneity

body.zh: 每个人自己的钟和身体过程都照常进行。地面系测得飞船钟较慢，飞船系测得地面钟较慢。两种说法比较的是各自参考系中同时发生的事件；相隔两地的“同时”随参考系改变，因此不矛盾。两钟在共同原点设为零。切换参考系保留同一个飞船钟事件，改变与它同时的地面钟事件；时空图始终采用地面坐标，横轴为 x/c、纵轴为 t。地面系的同时线水平，飞船系的同时线满足 t − vx/c² = 常数。以 0.8c、飞船钟 6 秒为例，两种同时线分别选中地面钟 10 秒和 3.6 秒；这不是地面钟倒走。颜色身份保持不变。这是同一匀速过程的两种描述，不是一次真实的加速、掉头或重逢。
body.en: Everyone’s own clock and bodily processes run normally. The ground frame measures the ship clock as slower; the ship frame measures the ground clock as slower. Each comparison pairs events that are simultaneous in its own frame. Frames disagree on distant simultaneity, so the results are consistent. Both clocks are set to zero at their shared origin. Switching frames preserves one ship-clock event and changes which ground-clock event is simultaneous with it. The spacetime diagram always uses ground coordinates, with x/c horizontally and t vertically. Ground-frame simultaneity is horizontal; ship-frame simultaneity obeys t − vx/c² = constant. At 0.8c, the ship-clock event at 6 seconds pairs with ground-clock readings of 10 or 3.6 seconds. This does not make the ground clock run backward. Their color identities stay fixed. These are two descriptions of uniform motion, not a physical acceleration, turnaround, or reunion.

label.zh: 光子没有静止参考系
label.en: A photon has no rest frame

body.zh: 在标准模型中，光子的静止质量为零，它仍携带能量。在真空中，光子以 c 传播，没有静止参考系。有静止质量的钟不能被加速到 c，因此不能把接近光速的运动钟当作“光子自己的钟”，也不能定义“光子眼中的时间停止”。
body.en: In the Standard Model, a photon has zero rest mass and still carries energy. It travels at c in vacuum and has no rest frame. A clock with rest mass cannot be accelerated to c. A near-light-speed clock therefore cannot stand in for a photon’s own clock, and “time stopping from a photon’s viewpoint” has no defined inertial frame.

label.zh: 画面与真实尺度
label.en: Visual presentation and physical scale

body.zh: 光带、探测闪光、镜面尺寸和转场采用艺术化呈现。波长被放大，传播速度与曝光节奏经过调整，空间投影不按统一比例。光钟读数与反射相位按同一模拟时间累计。为保持镜面可见，光路只显示循环的局部空间窗口；窗口归位不重置时间和拍数。两只钟在画面中的间隔不是实际距离，完整事件关系以固定地面坐标的时空图为准。相对速度范围为 0–0.95c，调速会重新开始一个匀速片段。不模拟加速、引力、多普勒效应或介质色散。三段场景分别说明量子探测、电磁波和光钟，转场不表示一颗真实光子的完整旅程。数值来自理论模型，没有使用实验测量数据。
body.en: The light bands, detection flashes, mirror sizes, and transitions are artistic representations. Wavelengths are enlarged, propagation and exposure timing are adjusted, and spatial projection does not use one common scale. Clock readouts and reflection phases accumulate using the same simulation time. To keep mirrors visible, the light paths use repeating local spatial windows; repositioning a window never resets elapsed time or tick counts. The separation of the displayed clocks is not their physical distance; the spacetime diagram in fixed ground coordinates gives the full event relationship. Relative speed ranges from 0 to 0.95c; changing it restarts a segment at the new constant speed. Acceleration, gravity, Doppler effects, and material dispersion are omitted. The three scenes illustrate quantum detection, electromagnetic waves, and light clocks. Their transitions do not describe one real photon making the entire journey. All readings come from theoretical models rather than experimental measurements.

hook.zh: 在一条跨越十一个数量级的频谱街道上飞行：中波、短波、调频、电视、GPS、WiFi、微波炉、5G 毫米波、热成像，直到尽头那一小段可见光。缩放到任意街区，看它内部被切成多少个信道；切到波长图层，用日常物体量一量一个波长真的有多长。
hook.en: Fly down a spectrum street eleven orders of magnitude long: medium wave, shortwave, FM, television, GPS, Wi-Fi, the microwave oven, 5G millimetre wave, thermal imaging, and finally the sliver of visible light at the end. Zoom into any block to see how it is cut into channels, or switch to the wavelength layer and measure one wave against everyday objects.

payoff.zh: 频率与波长互为倒数：λ = c / f。波长越长越容易绕过墙角、穿墙损耗也越小，所以 2.4 GHz 比 5 GHz 更能穿墙；而频率越高，能划给你的带宽越宽，所以 5 GHz 更快——这不是两种技术，而是同一条标尺的两端。频谱还是有限且被切好卖掉的地产：2021 年美国把 3.7–3.98 GHz 拍出 811.7 亿美元。整条标尺跨了十一个数量级，你的眼睛只看得见不到一个。
payoff.en: Frequency and wavelength are reciprocals: λ = c / f. Longer waves bend around corners more easily and lose less energy crossing a wall, which is why 2.4 GHz reaches through a house better than 5 GHz; higher frequencies can be granted wider blocks, which is why 5 GHz is faster. These are not two technologies but two ends of one ruler. The spectrum is also finite real estate that gets carved up and sold: in 2021 the United States auctioned 3.7–3.98 GHz for $81.17 billion. The whole ruler spans eleven orders of magnitude, and your eyes receive less than one of them.

question.zh: 外面那道彩虹从哪里来，为什么更淡、颜色相反，两圈之间还更暗？
question.en: Where does the outer rainbow come from, and why is it fainter and reversed, with darker sky between the two arcs?

hook.zh: 先看天空里的双彩虹，再走进水滴，比较一次和两次反射。改变太阳高度与水滴大小，看彩虹下沉，或淡成白色的雾虹。
hook.en: Start with a double rainbow, then enter a drop to compare one reflection with two. Change the Sun’s height and the drop size to lower the bows or blend their colours into a pale fogbow.

payoff.zh: 主虹来自水滴内的一次反射，副虹来自两次反射。多一次反射让外圈更淡、颜色反转；两圈之间缺少这两类光路送来的光，形成较暗的亚历山大暗带。
payoff.en: One internal reflection makes the primary bow; two make the secondary. The extra reflection makes the outer bow fainter and reverses its colours. Less light from these two paths reaches the gap, forming Alexander’s dark band.

label.zh: 外圈：副虹，也叫霓
label.en: The outer arc: the secondary rainbow

body.zh: 外面较淡的一圈来自阳光在水滴里反射两次。每次碰到水面，都有一部分光透出去，最后留下的光较少。主虹外红内紫；副虹内红外紫，所以两道红边隔着暗带相对。主虹的色带约在 41°–42°，副虹约在 50°–53°；角度都从背向太阳的方向量起。
body.en: The outer arc comes from sunlight reflecting twice inside a drop. Some light escapes at each encounter with the surface, leaving less for the secondary bow. The primary has red outside and violet inside; the secondary has red inside and violet outside. Their red edges face one another across the dark gap. The primary spans roughly 41°–42°, the secondary 50°–53°, measured from the direction opposite the Sun.

label.zh: 为什么两圈之间更暗
label.en: Why the gap looks darker

body.zh: 一次反射的光主要落在主虹以内，两次反射的光落在副虹以外。两道红边之间，大约 42°–50° 的方向，缺少这两类光路送来的光，所以比两侧更暗。这就是亚历山大暗带。那里仍有普通天光和其他散射光，并不是一圈黑暗的空洞。
body.en: Once-reflected light falls inside the primary bow; twice-reflected light falls outside the secondary. Between their red edges, roughly 42°–50°, these two paths contribute very little light. This relative deficit is Alexander’s dark band. Ordinary skylight and other scattered light remain there.

label.zh: 白光怎样分成颜色
label.en: How white light separates into colours

body.zh: 水对不同波长的光折射程度不同。白色阳光进出水滴时，红光与紫光沿不同方向离开。对同一位观察者，某个方向的雨滴送来的光以某些颜色为主，许多方向连起来就形成色带。彩虹是连续的光谱，「七色」只是便于描述的分法。
body.en: Water bends different wavelengths by different amounts, so red and violet light leave a drop in different directions. For one observer, drops in a particular direction contribute some wavelengths more strongly than others. Together these directions form the coloured bands. The spectrum is continuous; seven colours are a convenient way to describe it.

label.zh: 42° 和 51° 怎样出现
label.en: Where 42° and 51° come from

body.zh: 移动入射点，光离开水滴的方向会变化。在某个位置附近，许多相邻光线的出射方向几乎不变，光便集中成亮边，称为焦散。主虹约 42° 是一次反射光偏离回头方向的最大角；副虹约 51° 是两次反射光的最小角。光路遵循斯涅尔定律：sin i = n sin r。i 是入射角，r 是折射角，n 是水的折射率。
body.en: Moving the entry point changes a ray’s outgoing direction. Near a turning point, neighbouring rays leave in almost the same direction, creating a bright caustic. About 42° is the maximum return angle for one reflection; about 51° is the minimum for two. The paths follow Snell’s law: sin i = n sin r, where i is the incidence angle, r the refraction angle, and n the refractive index of water.

label.zh: 彩虹有一整圈，为什么只看见弧
label.en: Why a full circle looks like an arc

body.zh: 彩虹的圆心在背向太阳的方向，接近你头部影子的方向。站在平地上时，下半圈通常被地面挡住，或没有合适的水滴送光；从飞机或高处向下看，如果下方有阳光照亮的水滴，就可能看到完整圆虹。本场景演示的是平地前方的雨幕。
body.en: The centre is opposite the Sun, in the direction of your head’s shadow. At ground level, the lower part is usually blocked or lacks droplets to send light. From an aircraft or another high viewpoint, sunlit droplets below you can complete the circle. This scene models a rain curtain ahead of an observer on flat ground.

label.zh: 太阳升高，彩虹为什么下沉
label.en: Why a higher Sun makes a lower rainbow

body.zh: 太阳每升高一度，彩虹圆心就向下移一度。主虹顶部的高度大约等于 42° 减去太阳高度；副虹的圆更大，落到地平线下要更晚。太阳高于约 42° 时，平地上通常看不到前方地平线以上的主虹。但从高处向下看瀑布水雾等，仍可能看见；正午的太阳也并非处处都高于 42°。
body.en: For each degree the Sun rises, the bow’s centre drops a degree. The primary’s top is roughly 42° minus the Sun’s elevation. The larger secondary remains above the horizon longer. Above about 42°, the primary is normally below the horizon for a ground-level observer. Looking down at spray from a high viewpoint can still reveal it, and the midday Sun is not always above 42°.

label.zh: 雾虹和细条纹，和副虹有什么不同
label.en: Fogbows and fine fringes are different phenomena

body.zh: 雾滴很小，衍射让色带变宽、互相重叠，形成近乎白色的雾虹。另一种现象是主虹紫边内侧紧挨着的几条浅色细弧，叫干涉虹或附加虹；它们来自光波干涉，容易出现在水滴大小比较一致时。它们与远在外侧、由两次反射形成的副虹不同。本作近似演示雾虹的展宽，不绘制干涉条纹。
body.en: Tiny fog droplets spread the colours through diffraction, producing a broad, nearly white fogbow. Narrow pastel arcs just inside the primary’s violet edge are supernumerary bows. They arise from wave interference and are clearer when drop sizes are similar. They differ from the distant secondary arc, which comes from two reflections. This model approximates fogbow broadening but does not render interference fringes.

label.zh: 走近彩虹，换了哪些雨滴
label.en: What changes when you walk

body.zh: 彩虹由太阳、水滴和你的眼睛共同决定。你移动时，给你送光的雨滴换了，但它们仍在相近的角度上，所以不能像靠近一座桥那样走到彩虹脚下。左右走到雨幕边缘，弧会缺一块；走出这片雨后，如果前方不再有水滴，彩虹就消失。
body.en: The Sun, the drops and your eye together determine the rainbow. As you move, different drops send light at nearly the same angles. You cannot approach its foot as you would a bridge. Move towards the edge of the rain curtain and part of the arc disappears; pass beyond it with no droplets ahead and the bow vanishes.

label.zh: 雨滴的形状与模型边界
label.en: Drop shape and model limits

body.zh: 小雨滴接近球形，大雨滴会被气流压扁。本作按球形水滴计算折射、一次或两次反射、色散和菲涅尔能量损失。水滴大小控件表示半径，0.5 mm 半径对应约 1 mm 直径。雾虹只用近似衍射展宽，未模拟完整波动光学、偏振或非球形雨滴。天空、地面和亮度经过艺术化处理，副虹显示亮度适度增强以便辨认；雨滴被放大，雨幕被简化为竖直雨带。侧面视图标示的是送进观察者眼里的光，不是旁观镜头会看到的真实色彩。
body.en: Small drops are nearly spherical; larger raindrops flatten in the airflow. The model uses spherical drops, refraction, one or two reflections, dispersion and Fresnel energy losses. The size control reports radius: 0.5 mm corresponds to a diameter of about 1 mm. Fogbow width uses an approximate diffraction model; full wave optics, polarization and nonspherical drops are omitted. Sky, ground and brightness are artistically graded; the secondary is modestly brightened for readability. Visible drops are enlarged and rain is simplified to a vertical curtain. The side view shows the light sent to the observer, not the colours a separate camera would actually see.

hook.zh: 镜头从站在秤上的你钻进手指，一路到原子、原子核和一个质子。先猜，再把质子里的三颗夸克拖上秤；之后走进博物馆，拼质子、看 17 种基本粒子和它们被发现的证据。
hook.en: The camera dives from you on a scale into your finger, through an atom and a nucleus into one proton. Guess, then drag its three quarks onto a scale. Then walk into the museum: build protons, meet all 17 elementary particles and the evidence for each.

payoff.zh: 你的体重只有约 1% 来自夸克本身，另外 99% 是把夸克锁在质子和中子里的能量。希格斯机制给了夸克和电子质量，但核子的大部分质量来自强相互作用能量。动画为定性示意；标准模型尚不包含引力，也不能完整解释中微子质量。
payoff.en: Only about 1% of your weight is the quarks themselves; the other 99% is the energy that locks them inside protons and neutrons. The Higgs mechanism gives quarks and electrons their mass, but most nucleon mass comes from strong-interaction energy. These animations are qualitative. The Standard Model does not include gravity or fully explain neutrino mass.

question.zh: 三颗星为什么能跳出花朵、蝴蝶和立体的舞？
question.en: Why can three stars trace flowers, butterflies, and a dance in space?

hook.zh: 先看八组正在三维空间里积分的周期解。三个点质量只受万有引力；空间解会离开水平面，平面解始终贴在一张纸上。点开一条细看，也可以轻轻一碰，看舞怎样散场。
hook.en: Eight live integrations in three-dimensional space come first. Three point masses, Newtonian gravity only: spatial solutions leave the horizontal plane; planar solutions stay on one sheet. Open one to watch the dance, or nudge it and watch the dance break.

payoff.zh: 一般三体没有椭圆那样的通用公式，但特殊初值下存在周期解。这些解分两类：平面解始终贴在一张纸上；空间解会离开那个平面。本页把发表过的初值拿来当场积分，不是把论文里的图贴上去。
payoff.en: The general three-body problem has no ellipse-like formula, but special initial conditions still yield periodic orbits. Those solutions come in two geometries: planar orbits stay on one sheet; spatial orbits leave that plane. This page integrates published initial conditions live. It does not paste figures from the papers.

label.zh: 平面还是三维
label.en: Planar or spatial

body.zh: 三体问题本身在三维空间里。如果初值贴在一个平面、速度也贴着这个平面，轨迹会一直留在这张纸上，这叫平面周期解。给一个离面的 z 或 vz，一般会离开这个平面。名解、等质量 695、不等质量 1349 都是平面族；2025 年那一批才是空间周期解。
body.en: The three-body problem lives in three-dimensional space. If the initial positions and velocities lie in one plane, the motion stays on that sheet: a planar periodic orbit. A nonzero out-of-plane z or vz usually leaves the plane. Named dances, the 695 equal-mass families, and the 1,349 unequal-mass families are planar. The 2025 catalog is spatial.

label.zh: 本页怎么用论文
label.en: How this page uses the papers

body.zh: 没有复制论文的图、动画或程序。每一格都用牛顿引力和三维自适应 RK4，对发表过的初值当场积分。恒星在动，轨迹是它们走出来的。空间页从 2025 年发现的 10059 条里收录全部线性稳定解、钢琴三重奏解和各质量最短轨道，共 2416 条。
body.en: This page does not copy figures, movies, or code from the papers. Each cell integrates published initial conditions under Newtonian gravity with adaptive 3D RK4. The stars are moving; the trails are the paths they take. The spatial tab holds 2,416 orbits from the 10,059 found in 2025: every linearly stable orbit, every piano-trio orbit, and the shortest orbit of each mass.

label.zh: 底栏四族
label.en: The four atlas families

body.zh: 底栏「经典舞」对应有名字的平面解（8 字、蝴蝶、蛾）。「三颗一样重」是 2017 年 695 族平面解。「第三颗不同」是 2018 年 1349 族。「3D空间解」是 2025 年的空间解。
body.en: Named dances are the planar orbits with names (figure-eight, butterfly, moth). Same mass is the 2017 catalog of 695 planar families. Third mass differs is the 2018 catalog of 1,349 families. 3D spatial is the 2025 spatial catalog.

label.zh: 模型边界
label.en: Model limits

body.zh: 三个点质量，只有牛顿引力。没有潮汐、质量损失和相对论。周期模式在一个周期结束时回到发表的初值，并断开轨迹，避免画出穿过空旷空间的直线。微扰模式关闭复位。浏览器双精度会让极不稳定的轨道慢慢偏离。
body.en: Three point masses and Newtonian gravity only. No tides, mass loss, or relativity. After one period, periodic mode reseeds the published initial conditions and breaks the trail so it does not draw a chord through empty space. Nudge mode turns that reset off. Browser rounding can slowly unwind very unstable orbits.
